test_title: PYST 20: SSC CGL - Reasoning (Held On : 21 April 2022 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Three different positions of the same dice are shown. Select the letter that will be on the face opposite to the face having the letter 'C'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bf5b847939f91022aa51bbc266c04c35e8a8baaae1a1a0ceea559a7214fb5e6b.png]
solution:
As E is the common face in 2nd and 3rd dice, keeping it constant and rotating in clockwise direction, we get the faces opposite to each other:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/34cfe5ca07862cba6179829caf69ff48c841fa8df6adc229b6733a507106c1e6.png] 

 
 

 
 
E

 
 
 
B

 
 
 
C

 
 
 

 
 
E

 
 
 
A

 
 
 
D

 
 
 

Clearly, D will be on the face opposite to the face having the letter 'C'.

Hence, '**D**' is the correct answer.
